description: Debezium row of inventory.accounts -> account document: credit_currency defaulted to base_currency, credit_limit_minor -> credit_limit in major units

script.description: credit_currency null = base_currency. Minor units -> major units with the ISO 4217 exponent of the credit currency (JPY / KRW 0, BHD / KWD 3, else 2). opened_at: MicroTimestamp -> ISO-8601
script.source: if (ctx.credit_currency == null) { ctx.credit_currency = ctx.base_currency; } Map exponents = ['JPY': 0, 'KRW': 0, 'BHD': 3, 'KWD': 3]; if (ctx.credit_limit_minor instanceof Number) { int e = exponents.getOrDefault(ctx.credit_currency, 2); ctx.credit_limit = ((Number) ctx.credit_limit_minor).longValue() / Math.pow(10, e); } if (ctx.opened_at instanceof Number) { ctx.opened_at = Instant.EPOCH.plus(((Number) ctx.opened_at).longValue(), ChronoUnit.MICROS).toString(); }
